Whether you're a first-time owner or have loved sighthounds for years, you'll always find a warm welcome. Join our Facebook group to stay up to date with future pack walks, events and everything happening in our wonderful greyhound community. https://www.facebook.com/share/g/1LETN2sr55/?mibextid=wwXIfr .
